build_dual_fun: build the dual function that computes an upper bound on the neural network verification objective using inner/outer lagrangian parameters
create_innermaxstrategy: create a subclass of InnerMaxStrategy to solve inner maximization problems for neural network verification
init_duals_innermaxstrategy: initialize dual parameters and their types for functional lagrangian neural network verification
make_opt_and_num_steps: make an optax optimizer and compute the number of training steps with configurable learning rate annealing
project_dual: project dual variables onto their feasible constraint sets for inner and outer optimization
